description: This file contains jQuery-based functions for handling AJAX file uploads, including creating upload iframes and forms, error handling, and processing upload responses.

methods.name: createUploadIframe
methods.description: Creates an iframe element for file upload, with optional URI source.

methods.name: createUploadForm
methods.description: Creates a form element for file upload, clones the file input element, and appends it to the form.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Handles errors during AJAX requests, triggers error callbacks.

methods.name: ajaxFileUpload
methods.description: Performs AJAX file upload using hidden iframe and form, manages callbacks and response processing.

methods.name: uploadHttpData
methods.description: Processes the response data from upload, supports XML, JSON, script, and HTML types.
